description: This is a PHP source file defining the ThemeService class, which manages theme-related functionalities such as retrieving theme images, variables, and URLs, utilizing caching and external dependencies like ThemeDao and ScssHelper.

classes.name: ThemeService
classes.description: Service class responsible for managing theme assets, variables, and URLs, with caching, cache invalidation, and integration with external DAOs and helpers in the OrangeHRM platform.

methods.name: getThemeDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the ThemeDao instance for database interactions related to themes.

methods.name: getScssHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the ScssHelper instance for styling helper functions like lighten, darken, and rgba.

methods.name: getImageETag
methods.description: Retrieves the ETag for a specific theme image (client logo, banner, login banner) from cache or cache-misses to generate it.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Fetches the theme image object from cache, loading from DAO if not present.

methods.name: getImageETagAlongWithCache
methods.description: Helper method to fetch and cache both the image content and its ETag.

methods.name: getCurrentThemeVariables
methods.description: Returns the current theme variables, falling back to default if custom theme is unavailable, utilizing cache.

methods.name: showSocialMediaImages
methods.description: Indicates whether social media icons should be shown, based on the current theme.

methods.name: getDerivedCssVariables
methods.description: Generates an array of CSS variables derived from theme variables, including color manipulations.

methods.name: getClientLogoURL
methods.description: Constructs URL to the client logo image, using cache ETags to determine if fallback is needed.

methods.name: getClientBannerURL
methods.description: Constructs URL to the client banner image, with fallback logic.

methods.name: getLoginBannerURL
methods.description: Constructs URL to the login banner image, with fallback.
